LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdMegaDockDesc: Dock at one of the megastructures here. You arrive at one section of it; walk through the bulkhead doors at either end of a deck to reach the next section.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdMegaSupplyDesc: Send the materials for the next stage to the work crews in orbit. Needs: {0}. The stage then takes about {1} days while this node has power.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdMegaUndockDesc: Leave the megastructure and return to open orbit.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicDesc_Cluster: A cluster: hundreds of galaxies held together by their own gravity, bathed in hot gas.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicDesc_Group: A galaxy group: a handful of galaxies sharing one neighbourhood.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicDesc_LargeGroup: A large group: a few dozen galaxies falling slowly toward each other.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicDesc_Supercluster: A supercluster: thousands of galaxies bound loosely along one stretch of the web.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicDesc_Web: The cosmic web: filaments of dark matter and gas, with superclusters strung along them and great voids between.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicFar: Far beyond the reach of any drive you have.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CosmicHome: Your ship is somewhere inside this.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GalaxyClickHelp: Click anywhere on the galaxy to open that sector.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GridHelp: Click a cell to look closer. Scroll to zoom in or out.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GridScale: View: {0} ly across, cells of {1} ly
LanguageData.Rimverse_InBar: Inside the galactic bar: denser stars and faster routes.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterBaseClearedDesc: The last defenders of the {0} are down. The base is yours to strip: whatever is left in its holds can be carried back to your ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterMegaStageDesc: The {0} has reached a new stage: {1} ({2}/{3}). The work goes on far out in orbit, and the structure now gives more of what it was built for.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MegaInspectNeedsSupply: Waiting for the next stage to be supplied.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgMegaDocked: Docked at the {0}. A gangway leads to the nearest airlock.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgMegaSection: {0} crossed into section {2} of {3} of the {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgMegaSupplied: Materials sent: work on the {0} continues.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgTraderDocked: {0} has come alongside. Walk to its trade terminal to trade in person, or call it on the comms console.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgTraderLeft: The trader has cast off and left.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RG_MegaStage: {0} just finished a new stage of the {1}: {2}. You can see it from orbit.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SectorEmpty: Nearly empty: no star systems charted here.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SysBeyondFrost: Beyond the frost line: ices stay frozen here.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SysInHabitable: Inside the habitable zone: liquid water is possible.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SysLegend: Green band: habitable zone. Dashed blue ring: frost line. Coloured halo: settled world.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SysZoomHelp: Scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TerminalNoTrader: No trader linked to this terminal right now.
